title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: Loss functions are used to measure how well a model's predictions match the actual data. Some loss functions penalize outliers more harshly than others. Consider how the power of the difference between actual and predicted values affects the penalty on outliers.

title: Mean Squared Error (MSE)
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) is calculated as sum{i extbackslash=n}{1}{n}{(y_i- extbackslash hat{y}_i)**2}. It penalizes larger errors more than smaller ones, but there are other functions that penalize even more harshly.

title: Higher Powers and Absolute Values
text: Consider how using higher powers or absolute values in the loss function affects the penalty on outliers. Functions with higher powers or absolute values tend to penalize outliers more harshly.
